entities.name: The Renaissance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The cultural rebirth of Europe (c. 1400–1600) that saw a revival of classical learning, revolutionary advances in art, architecture, science, and literature. Beginning in Italian city-states, it spread across Europe and laid the foundation for the modern world.
